title: NIT Silchar Notification 2026 - Apply for Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: The National Institute of Technology Silchar (NIT Silchar) has issued the official notification for the recruitment of Junior Research Fellow positions. Candidates who have qualified in M.E/ M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering can grab this chance and apply for the NIT Silchar Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
